x-changelog.summary: Introducing v1.0 Sync Budget Line Items endpoint
x-changelog.description:
The Sync Budget Line Items endpoint is a new endpoint that allows developers to create and update Budget Line Items in bulk.
It has a limit of 500 updates/inserts per request.

For each Budget Line Item one of two parameters are necessary, 'wbs_code_id' or 'id'.
In case of using 'wbs_code_id' and already exists a Budget Line Item assigned to a WBS Code, it will update the Budget Line Item, otherwise, it will create a new Budget Line Item.

x-changelog.description: Each budget line item object now contains the currency_configuration object.
